title: attract magnet telegraph misses upgrades of non-representative parallel-bundle pipes
detail: Hop.pipe is only the lowest-slot representative of a bundle. Upgrading a parallel pipe that is not the representative lowers the predicted edge cost (min semantics) and attracts traffic through the bundle, but attract stays false — the telegraph under-reports.
recommended_fix: In the attract scan, mark true when any live pipe between the hop's node pair has id == pipe (e.g. check t.pipe_a/pipe_b per slot) instead of comparing the representative id.
